title: Econometrics REITInflationPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed econometric analysis of REIT returns and inflation. Generated comprehensive report with: 1) Descriptive statistics showing strong correlation (0.931), 2) Regression analysis revealing inflation beta of 0.156 (p<0.001), 3) Granger causality tests showing no predictive relationship, 4) VAR analysis with impulse response functions, 5) Regime analysis demonstrating higher REIT returns in high inflation periods, and 6) Policy implications for investment and monetary policy. All deliverables created: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and publication-quality report in report/report.md with 6 figures.
